resources.string: Often associated with Dracula, Bran Castle is a national monument and landmark in Romania. The fortress is situated on the border between Transylvania and Wallachia.
The Palace of Parliament in Bucharest is the world\'s largest civilian building with an administrative function and the most expensive administrative building.
Known as the \"Sistine Chapel of the East\", the Voroneț Monastery is famous for its unique shade of blue used in its frescoes, known as \"Voroneț Blue\".
A Neo-Renaissance castle in the Carpathian Mountains, built between 1873 and 1914. It was the summer residence of the Romanian royal family.
One of the most spectacular roads in the world, the Transfăgărășan is the second-highest paved road in Romania, crossing the Făgăraș Mountains.
